class.name: AudioBusSettingsRow
class.brief_description: One bus in the settings file of [AudioBusSettingsServer].
class.description: The storage form of an [AudioBusSettings]: one row of the file [code]user://settings/audio_bus.<format>[/code] (one line of a CSV file). [AudioBusSettingsServer] writes only the values that the project stores ([member ProjectSettings.settings/audio_bus/store_volume], [member ProjectSettings.settings/audio_bus/store_mute], [member ProjectSettings.settings/audio_bus/store_solo]); when it reads a file, it accepts every value, ignores the values that are not stored and takes stored values that the row does not have from the bus layout. Games do not need this class: use [AudioBusSettingsServer] and [AudioBusSettings].

members.member: The name of the bus in the bus layout.
The stored mute state. Written only if the project stores it.
The stored solo state. Written only if the project stores it.
The stored volume in decibels, clamped to -80 dB … 24 dB. Written only if the project stores it.
